summary: Test records passing verdicts for the complete enforced set (both MUSTs; the SHOULD is excluded and that completeness is asserted), confirms check exits 0, then renames the spec file and asserts the old namespace is gone, both new stem-derived IDs are review targets again, and the real CLI check --json exits 1 with exactly two REQ-003.3.1 'no current review verdict' violations — the same rule as a never-reviewed requirement; a mutant deriving the namespace from the H1 title instead of the filename stem fails this test.
